headline: Pakistan IT Service Exports Reach Monthly Record of $453 Million in October
summary: Pakistan's IT sector exported $453 million in services during October 2026, marking an all-time monthly high and a 17.4% year-on-year increase.
why: IT service exports are a key source of foreign currency earnings for Pakistan's current account.

impacts.name: Pakistan
impacts.why: Monthly foreign currency revenue from tech services touched a historic high.
